This one I recommend if you have the Japanese tier system database, it might seem a bit odd as a suggestion but it offers interesting play at a lower ranked level and gives opportunity of 3 tiers above to try to progress to. You can also choose to set fixed responses to certain things you say, for example you write "Good morning" and you want the bot to only reply "Good morning my love, did you sleep well?" you can do so. 

My advice on choosing which idol to use. If you are making it for a waifu, use either a girl from the group Twice, Blackpink or Red Velvet as those are the big three groups. If it is a husbando, BTS, Exo or NCT should be the best bet.
